Across the male sequence, the planted feet and floor-mounted bar pivot drift left through frames 1 and 2 and return right in frame 3. The pivot also shifts vertically. This produces visible whole-setup sliding beyond the intended bar rotation and rowing motion.

All eight frames retain a ragged white/light-gray ground patch beneath and between the shoes, extending beyond the actual white soles. The patch is conspicuous against dark backgrounds and varies in outline across the animation. Fine light fringe is also visible around some contours, but the ground patch is the material defect.

Male frame 2 has a particularly large pale textured patch between raised arms. These areas remain white against the dark background.

Stationary bench and athlete scale/position change visibly within each sequence. Frame 2 enlarges the bench and body and shifts the bench left/up versus frames 0–1 and 3. Male frame 3 also has a longer bench/body than frame 1. These stationary geometry changes exceed the expected arm movement and will produce animation jumps.
